zh_CN: 护士站里，朝仓正把几份交班资料整理成一叠。看见坂口走近，她抬起头，笑着向他点了点头。
en: At the nurses' station, Asakura is gathering several handover sheets into a stack. Seeing Sakaguchi approach, she looks up and gives him a smiling nod.

zh_CN: 「坂口医生，来得正好。今天手术部那边的交接单，我刚整理到一半——」
en: “Doctor Sakaguchi, perfect timing. I'm halfway through sorting out today's handover sheets for the surgical department—”

zh_CN: 一名年轻护士抱着两张纸快步走来，几乎撞上护士站的柜台。
en: A young nurse hurries over clutching two sheets of paper, nearly colliding with the counter.

zh_CN: 「朝仓小姐，不好了！下一台手术临时提前了，手术室催着送人，病房那边却还按原来的安排准备！」
en: “Ms. Asakura, we have a problem! The next operation has been moved forward. The operating room is pushing us to bring the patient over, but the ward is still preparing according to the original schedule!”

zh_CN: 「手术时间改了？」
en: “The operation time changed?”

zh_CN: 「两张给我看看。」
en: “Let me see both sheets.”

zh_CN: 朝仓接过纸，先看日期，再看两张单据上的修订时间。
en: Asakura takes the papers, checks the dates, then compares the revision times on the two documents.

zh_CN: 「这一张是原排程，另一张刚改过，对吗？病房收到新安排了吗？患者的术前准备现在完成到哪一步？」
en: “This is the original schedule, and this one was just revised, correct? Has the ward received the update? How far along is the patient's preoperative preparation?”

zh_CN: 「是。手术室说他们都准备好了，一直催着送人。可是病房应该还没收到……准备情况我也还没核完。」
en: “Yes. The operating room says they're all ready and keeps asking us to bring the patient. But I don't think the ward has received it yet... I haven't finished checking the preparations, either.”

zh_CN: 「那就先别推。」
en: “Then don't move the patient yet.”

zh_CN: 「咦？可他们说已经在等了……」
en: “Huh? But they said they're already waiting...”

zh_CN: 「他们等的是准备妥当的患者，不是你手里这张改过时间的纸。」
en: “They're waiting for a properly prepared patient, not that sheet of paper with a revised time on it.”

zh_CN: 她说得很平静，却已把刚才的笑容收了起来。年轻护士下意识站直了。
en: Her voice is calm, but her smile has disappeared. The young nurse instinctively straightens up.

zh_CN: 「先和病房确认患者本人、术式和术前准备的交接状态。没有确认完的就说没有确认完，别用『应该』两个字顶上去。」
en: “First, confirm the patient's identity, the procedure, and the handover status of the preoperative preparations with the ward. If something hasn't been confirmed, say so. Don't substitute ‘probably’ for confirmation.”

zh_CN: 「明、明白。」
en: “U-understood.”

zh_CN: 「手术室我来联系。你负责病房，核完再来告诉我。别两边一起打电话，越打越乱。」
en: “I'll contact the operating room. You handle the ward and report back once you've checked. Don't call both sides at once; that'll only make things more confused.”

zh_CN: 「好！我这就去！」
en: “Right! I'll do it now!”

zh_CN: 年轻护士抱着资料走向护士站另一侧的电话。朝仓拿起桌上的听筒，迅速拨了号码。
en: The young nurse takes the paperwork to the phone at the other end of the station. Asakura picks up the receiver on the desk and quickly dials.

zh_CN: 「喂，手术室吗？我是朝仓。关于刚才提前的那位患者——病房还没有完成新的交接确认。对，暂时不能转运。排程要改当然可以，但病房也得收到同一份消息。」
en: “Hello, operating room? This is Asakura. About the patient whose operation was moved forward—the ward hasn't completed the updated handover checks. Yes, we can't transfer the patient yet. You can change the schedule, of course, but the ward needs to receive the same information.”

zh_CN: 「我知道你们在等。可是催得再急，也不能把没确认的事情当作确认过了。我们核好以后马上回电。」
en: “I know you're waiting. But no amount of rushing turns something unconfirmed into something confirmed. We'll call back as soon as we've checked.”

zh_CN: 朝仓放下听筒，把两张单据并排摊在柜台上。坂口站在一旁，看她用笔标出需要重新确认的部分。
en: Asakura hangs up and lays the two sheets side by side on the counter. Standing beside her, Sakaguchi watches as she marks the items that need to be checked again.

zh_CN: 「需要我去跟手术室说明吗？」
en: “Would you like me to explain the situation to the operating room?”

zh_CN: 「不用，现在是交接的问题。坂口医生先把这份最新的记录给我好吗？左边那张。」
en: “No, this is a handover issue. Doctor Sakaguchi, could you pass me the latest record first? The one on the left.”

zh_CN: 坂口递过纸。她看了一眼，发现拿到的是旧版，立刻又伸出手。
en: Sakaguchi hands her a sheet. She glances at it, realizes it's the old version, and immediately holds out her hand again.

zh_CN: 「不是这张。日期是今天的那张。」
en: “Not this one. The one with today's date.”

zh_CN: 「……抱歉，是这张吧。」
en: “...Sorry. This one, right?”

zh_CN: 「对，谢谢。」
en: “Yes, thank you.”

zh_CN: 「确认好了！患者那边的准备还需要一点时间，病房已经把情况说明清楚。手术室也同意按重新确认的时间接收。」
en: “Everything's checked! The patient's preparations still need a little more time, and the ward has explained the situation. The operating room has agreed to receive the patient at the reconfirmed time, too.”

zh_CN: 「好。现在双方拿的是同一版安排吧？」
en: “Good. Both sides have the same version of the schedule now?”

zh_CN: 「是！旧的那张也已经标注作废了。」
en: “Yes! The old one has been marked void, too.”

zh_CN: 「交给下一班的人也说一声，别让这件事下午再来一次。」
en: “Tell the next shift as well. Let's not go through this again this afternoon.”

zh_CN: 「好的。朝仓小姐，真是谢谢你！刚才我完全不知道该先找谁。」
en: “Of course. Thank you so much, Ms. Asakura! I had no idea whom to contact first.”

zh_CN: 「呵呵，下次先把两张单子放在一起看。跑得快不一定有用，跑错方向才是真的累。」
en: “Hehe. Next time, start by putting the two sheets side by side. Running fast doesn't always help. Running in the wrong direction is what really wears you out.”

zh_CN: 年轻护士松了口气，向两人鞠了一躬，抱着整理好的资料离开。
en: The young nurse sighs in relief, bows to them both, and leaves with the organized paperwork.

zh_CN: 「朝仓小姐，你刚才处理得真熟练。」
en: “Ms. Asakura, you handled that very smoothly.”

zh_CN: 「哎呀，被坂口医生看见我使唤人了。」
en: “Oh dear. You've caught me bossing people around, Doctor Sakaguchi.”

zh_CN: 「第一次见面时，你还说第一天有点紧张。我以为你对医院工作也不太熟悉。」
en: “When we first met, you said you were a little nervous on your first day. I thought you weren't very familiar with hospital work, either.”

zh_CN: 「我说的是来星见的第一天嘛。又不是今天才开始当护士。」
en: “I meant my first day at Hoshimi. It's not as though I only became a nurse today.”

zh_CN: 「原来如此。刚才那种语气，倒很像以前负责过不少人。」
en: “I see. The way you spoke just now sounded like someone who used to be in charge of quite a few people.”

zh_CN: 「呵呵，医生观察得真仔细。不过以前的事情，以后有机会再说吧。」
en: “Hehe. You're very observant, Doctor. But let's talk about the past some other time, when we have the chance.”

zh_CN: 「好。那我以后遇到交接问题，就先来请教你。」
en: “All right. Then I'll come to you first when I run into handover problems.”

zh_CN: 「可以呀。不过我可不会因为你是医生，就把『应该没问题』当成答案哦。」
en: “Of course. But I won't accept ‘it should be fine’ as an answer just because you're a doctor.”

zh_CN: 「这一点，我刚才已经见识过了。」
en: “Yes, I've already seen that for myself.”

zh_CN: 「那就好。以后也请多关照啦，坂口医生。」
en: “Good. I look forward to working with you, Doctor Sakaguchi.”
